description.default: Start / stop / restart the local whisper.cpp transcription service and manage its models (multi-backend CUDA / Vulkan / CPU). Must be used together with the "Local Speech Service" client script: this panel only runs the service and provides no voice input by itself.
description.zh-CN: 启动 / 停止 / 重启本地 whisper.cpp 转写服务并管理识别模型，支持 CUDA / Vulkan / CPU 多后端自动择优。需与「本地语音服务」客户端脚本配合使用：本面板只负责起服务，本身不提供语音输入。
